title: ArcFlow: 2-Step Non-Linear Image Generation Framework
summary: Developed by Microsoft Research Asia and Fudan University, ArcFlow utilizes non-linear flow distillation to generate high-quality images in just 2 steps. It significantly optimizes inference for large-scale models like FLUX.1 and Qwen-Image while maintaining visual fidelity.
research_notes: Unlike linear distillation methods like LCM, ArcFlow parameterizes the velocity field to capture non-linear trajectories, enabling 40x speedups with minimal quality loss.

evolution.summary: Since its release in early 2026, the project has expanded to support 20B-parameter models and has been optimized for consumer-grade GPUs (24GB VRAM). It is currently integrated into various open-source UI wrappers for fast diffusion inference.
